title: 6.9 Finding a Safe Way
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
goal: Understand can/cannot in a visible situation, then choose and follow an available route.
grammar_function: Ana’s first crossing is unavailable. A clearly pictured signal or barrier establishes why she cannot cross here. Luis indicates an available crossing there. Ana follows the short known route, crosses only where permitted, and continues to the museum.
prerequisite: Units 1–5 and the earlier Unit 6 lessons in the displayed course sequence.
speaking_outcome: Understand can/cannot in a visible situation, then choose and follow an available route.
